
'''Yuga Shrine''' or '''Yuga Shrine''' (由加神社 / 瑜伽神社, Yuga Jinja, Yūga Jinja)  

* [[Yuga Shrine|Yuga Shrine Honmiya]] - Located on Mount Yuga in [[Kojima, Kurashiki|Kojima]], [[Kurashiki City]], Okayama Prefecture.  
* Branch shrines of Yuga Shrine Honmiya. There are 52 branch shrines across Japan<ref>[http://www.yugasan.or.jp/massya-meguri/meguri01.html Yuga Shrine Pilgrimage] Yuga Shrine Honmiya</ref>.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Chūō-ku, Osaka)]] - Located in [[Chūō-ku, Osaka]], Osaka Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Nishinari-ku, Osaka)]] - Located in [[Nishinari-ku, Osaka]], Osaka Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Daijin]] - Located in [[Abeno-ku, Osaka]], Osaka Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Taishi Town)]] - Located in [[Taishi, Hyōgo|Taishi Town]], [[Ibo District, Hyōgo|Ibo District]], Hyōgo Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Inari Shrine]] - Located in [[Himeji]], Hyōgo Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Nara)|Yuga Shrine (Nara City)]] - Located in [[Takahata-chō, Nara]], on the slopes of Mount Yuga, Nara Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Naka-ku, Okayama)]] - Located in [[Naka-ku, Okayama]], Okayama Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Kita-ku, Okayama)]] - Located in [[Kita-ku, Okayama]], Okayama Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Kurashiki)]] - Located in [[Mizushima, Kurashiki]], Okayama Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Wake Town)]] - Located in [[Wake, Okayama|Wake Town]], [[Wake District]], Okayama Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Tokushima City)]] - Located in [[:en:Tokushima City|Tokushima City]], Tokushima Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Daibosatsu]] - Located in Tokushima City, Tokushima Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Komatsushima City)]] - Located in [[:en:Komatsushima|Komatsushima]], Tokushima Prefecture.  
** [[Iuga Shrine]] - Located in [[Naruto, Tokushima|Naruto City]], Tokushima Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Yoshinogawa City)]] - Located in [[:en:Yoshinogawa|Yoshinogawa]], Tokushima Prefecture.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Sakaide)]] - Located in [[:en:Sakaide|Sakaide]], Kagawa Prefecture. There are two shrines with the same name in the city.  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Usa City)]] - Located in [[Usa, Ōita|Usa City]], Ōita Prefecture, as a subordinate shrine of [[Usa Jingū]].  
** [[Yuga Palace]] - Located in [[:en:Kunisaki, Ōita|Kunisaki City]], Oita Prefecture, as a subordinate shrine of the [[Iwakura Shrine]].  
** [[Yuga Shrine (Usuki City)]] - Located in [[Usuki, Ōita|Usuki City]], Ōita Prefecture, as a subordinate shrine of [[Fukura Tenmangū]].
